metadata.title: Alphabet's stock is still expensive after recent pullback - MarketWatch

content.text:
35 min ago
Alphabet's stock is still expensive after recent pullback
Shares of Alphabet have retreated 14% from their record high of $404.44 achieved in May as AI jitters have hammered tech stocks.
Still, Alphabet's stock isn't cheap at 24x forward earnings, which is at the higher end of its historical range of 12x to 29x, according to RBC analyst Brad Erickson.
"Given the strong growth in the business over the last couple of years, unknown levels of future AI investment and the sheer size of the company, we think future growth and therefore multiple expansion are constrained to some extent," Erickson wrote in a Tuesday note.
